review_candidates.title: Deloitte Innovation Hub I End User Support Lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Establishing standardized procedures for workstation provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, replacement and decommissioning adhering with Deloitte policies and regulations. 7+ relevant years of experience.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: With your technical expertise and leadership capabilities you will ensure the availability, performance, security, compliance and lifecycle management of end-user devices and associated software and applications across Windows and Mac OS environments. Your technology hands-on experience in hardware, software, Active Directory, endpoint security, PC compliance and IT Service Operation will allow you to lead the day-to-day operation adhering to the agreed SLAs, OLAs and KPIs. 7+ relevant years of experience. Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing.
